text:
People still aren't getting it! So going to spell it out for you as to why you want this grokbot template to manage and orchestrate your entire Hermes Agent fleet from a single grok bot!

People are DM'ing me:

 "why use this grokbot template instead of just asking a grokbot to manage your Hermes fleet for you?"

What you can totally do by just asking any Grok Bot:  wire HTTP :8642, poke health/ask, tell it secrets live in Bitwarden, hope it remembers your Macs and doesn’t fall back to SSH or paste keys into chat.

BUT!

What this template already has that a blank bot doesn’t: 🤖the hard locks (HTTP-only talk path
🤖Bitwarden as SSOT
🤖no secret dumps
🤖per-profile messaging tokens)
🤖the skills (daily health, BWS inventory, wire native API, long-job Desktop :8642 escape, provider relogin, HERDR-orchestrates-only / don’t-debug-in-the-conductor)
🤖and the routines that actually run those checks. 
🤖Plus the sister split — API Fleet for the wire, SSH Relay only when you mean Desktop-primary — so installers don’t invent a fourth path.

Short version: any Grok Bot can chat at Hermes. This template is the BATTLE HARDNED ops doctrine + fail-loud habits already loaded, so you don’t re-teach fleet safety every session.  

🔽🔽🔽🔽🔽🔽🔽🔽🔽🔽🔽🔽🔽🔽🔽

https://x.ai/bot/rzq0UV2MmBsvVR1EspZE-

🔼🔼🔼🔼🔼🔼🔼🔼🔼🔼🔼🔼🔼🔼🔼
